lots.what_it_is: Mixed box of Marilyn Monroe and 1950s film paper: US-style 11x14 lobby cards (Niagara 1953 scene card, Bus Stop 1956, The Seven Year Itch with Tom Ewell, The Girl Can't Help It 1956 with Jayne Mansfield, Cape Fear, one other), a 1950 New Screen News cover (Virginia Mayo), a MacArthur cut-out, and several B&W and colour Monroe portrait prints that look modern, some in plastic sleeves. Originals vs reprints not confirmed.

lots.guide_summary: Only close entries count for the range: two 2019 RR Auction sales (premium included, 1 USD = 1.50 AUD), about AU$140 per original Monroe card in a 20-card archive and AU$412 for a premium Niagara title card. All sold, none unsold or asking. Gowans category results ($5 to $40 hammer) show Tasmanian buyers pay little for mixed film paper and modern Monroe prints. If the cards are period originals the 3 Monroe cards alone could be worth a few hundred dollars overseas; if reprints the box is a $20 to $50 lot.
lots.working: No same-item SOLD entry within the last 24 months (RR Auction sales are August 2019), so keep_max_hammer = 0 and flip_max_hammer = 0. Indicative only: original Monroe cards about AU$140 each (2019); 3 Monroe cards x $140 = $420 less 13% selling fees and $20 postage = about $345, / 2.44 = $140 would be the flip ceiling IF originality is confirmed and 2019 prices still hold. Not used as a maximum.
lots.confidence_reason: Titles read from the photos but originality (NSS numbers, card stock, printer credits) not visible; the only close sold evidence is over 24 months old and from the US; WebSearch budget exhausted so no Armitage past results, Heritage or dealer prices could be checked.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped. All 7 entries re-opened (RR Auction pages via WebFetch, Gowans via API JSON). Corrected the Niagara comparison: the RR card is a title card, ours is a scene card. Gowans lot 405179 confirmed from its photo as modern framed prints.
lots.key_photo_findings: Readable: Bus Stop (Marilyn Monroe, Don Murray, CinemaScope), Niagara scene card (Monroe, Joseph Cotten, Jean Peters, Technicolor, 20th Century Fox logo), The Seven Year Itch (Tom Ewell, CinemaScope), The Girl Can't Help It (Tom Ewell, Jayne Mansfield, Edmond O'Brien, CinemaScope), Cape Fear, New Screen News April 1950 Virginia Mayo cover, a MacArthur image with tape on it, a pink-toned period still, and glossy B&W and colour Monroe portraits that look like modern reproductions. Some cards show tape and edge wear.
lots.condition: Cards show edge wear, possible tape remnants and fading; prints appear modern and some are sleeved. Originality unconfirmed.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are the lobby cards original 1950s release cards? Please check the bottom margin for an NSS number and year (for example 53/xxx or 56/xxx), the printer credit and 'Country of origin U.S.A.', and whether the stock is card or thin paper. How many lobby cards are in the box in total, and do any have tears, tape or trimmed edges?
